== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The [[Fallen Leaf]] School is one of the four major organizations in the [[Sacred Valley]], operating on a level far above other groups. Located on [[Yoma Mountain]], which is filled with purple [[orus trees]], the school resembles a celestial village or a farming community, featuring tilled fields, barns, and lush greenery. The school maintains a monopoly on many trees capable of producing [[spirit-fruit]]; they process these fruits into various products for sale and create secret [[elixirs]] to enhance their own students. They also sell a product known as [[Oblivion Wine]] one year after the [[Nethergate]] opens. The school controls the [[Nethergate]], a massive thirty-meter-high entrance to labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth that forms the foundation of the [[Sacred Valley]]. This gate, which features an image of a [[Dreadgod]], opens every ten years to allow the school's elders to collect treasures from labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth's upper levels. The [[Fallen Leaf]] School is represented by purple robes and an ivy crown, and its members utilize [[green madra]]. Their security forces include guards and enforcers who use specialized techniques to protect their territory and resources.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Located just outside a lonely corner where [[Yerin]] was sitting, the [[Fallen Leaf]] School serves as the base for a group possessing thirty-two [[Jades]]. Although it was considered a potential destination for the traveling group, the school would not offer protection to the exiles. The organization maintains specific methods for contacting other schools and is home to [[Orthos]]. During the events, cloudships were confiscated from the school's possession.}}
